name: English
title: Open Agent Systems — Open foundations for AI
description: An open-source community building composable foundations for the AI-native ecosystem. Build, connect, and operate intelligent systems together.
headline: Build what’s next.
intro: We’re bringing people, tools, and infrastructure together to make AI systems easier to build, connect, and operate.
purposeText: Progress in AI shouldn’t mean rebuilding the same foundations. We’re working toward an ecosystem where models, agents, tools, and runtimes can work together—with clear boundaries and room to grow.
purposeNote: Open Agent Systems (OAS) is an open-source organization. We start with real engineering needs and build toward a connected AI-native ecosystem, one contribution at a time.
focusIntro: Four connected areas guide our work. They describe our direction, not a list of capabilities already delivered.
areas: Make AI useful throughout coding, testing, delivery, and collaboration. Improve the everyday experience of building software.
Connect reusable skills, tools, and workflows so developers can compose intelligent applications around real needs.
Build toward dependable execution, deployment, resource management, and observability for AI workloads.
Help independent projects work together. Reduce integration friction and make useful capabilities easier to reuse.
principles: Share the work. Welcome different perspectives. Make room for meaningful contributions.
Keep boundaries clear and interfaces understandable, so independent capabilities work together.
Treat usability, documentation, and the day-to-day developer experience as part of the product.
Start with real problems. Value maintainable implementations and verifiable results.
joinText: A useful ecosystem starts with real needs. Share a use case, suggest a connection, or help shape what comes next.
